_doc: Card rarity (design/card-rarity.md): tiers in order; weights per hand slot by source (level, chest, gold_chest); pity_step moves points from common to epic per common / rare slot (level only), reset on epic+; (the deck point budget lives in card_trees.json deck: budget, cost); fillers fill a slot the deck cannot (no level).

level_curve._doc: Level-up odds by run level (user 2026-11-21): start at level 1, add per_level for each level after, each tier clamped to [min, max], then scaled to 100. The table is shown on the Bộ thẻ screen and the dashboard.
